messages:
sophia: hey @devex, can't get first call to succeed after creating workspace. curl returns 403 with body 'billing_required' even though we added a card in workspace settings. cc @matt

matt: what does the curl look like?

sophia: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}'```
response: 403 {"error":"billing_required","message":"workspace requires billing setup"}

zara: did you confirm the workspace id and env? SDKs sometimes prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY. also check REDWOOD_ORG_ID.

sophia: i'm using REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY. also noticed `token refresh failed: 401` in local logs right before the 403

devex-bot: System: Workspace 12345 flagged for manual review due to suspicious card auth. Contact billing@redwood.ai

sophia: portal shows card active and billing status 'active' though :confused:

matt: could be a fraud/avs hold. @billing-team can you check workspace 12345? looks like a hold -> auth loop -> 403

billing-team: checking. we see 3 failed auth attempts from IP 34.82.120.11, AVS mismatch. put a fraud hold. sent verification email to workspace admin.

zara: for DX: SDK should map that to an explicit `billing_hold` error with a help link. right now it's just 403.

sophia: any quick workaround so I can demo in 30m? regen key? bypass?

matt: short term: create a fresh workspace and add a card correctly, or ask billing to lift the hold. i pushed a tiny SDK change to improve the error message (PR #4287).

devex-bot: Deploy status: PR #4287 merged to dev -> deploy scheduled in 5m.

billing-team: lifted hold for workspace 12345 for 1 hour. try again.

sophia: ok curl now returns 200, first tokens! :tada: thanks everyone

matt: follow-up: filed devex backlog task to map billing error codes -> actionable messages and docs. assigning to @zara.

zara: thanks — i'll add UX mock and SDK tests, include link to billing appeal flow.
